question_text: Barangay Mapayapa passed an ordinance prohibiting discrimination against persons with disabilities (PWDs) in employment, public accommodations, and access to services. A local business owner, Mr. Cruz, refuses to hire a qualified PWD applicant solely because of his disability. Under the ordinance, what is the most appropriate initial legal remedy for the applicant?

options.text: File a criminal complaint directly with the Regional Trial Court
File a complaint with the Barangay Council for the Protection of PWDs
File a complaint with the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE)
File a complaint with the Commission on Human Rights (CHR)
